verdicts.reason: Both use the same stacked layout. In each, the shoe is clipped flush at the circle's right edge, 'Full review inside.' is tiny and floats far below the image, and there is dead space under it and between the blocks. A leaves an empty band at the top with the NEW VIDEO badge floating in it; the logo sits low against the headline and the canvas starts on the badge, not the brand. B opens on the logo at the top and uses the badge as a kicker above the headline, so the reading order is better, though the gap between the badge and the headline is still loose.
